input:
If a = 2i + 3j + 2k, b = 2i + j - k and c = i + 3j are such that (a + lambda b) is perpendicular to c, then the value of lambda is

Options:
A. 5/11
B. 11/5
C. -11/5
D. -5/11

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find lambda so that vector (a + lambda b) is perpendicular to c.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Perpendicular vectors have zero dot product.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Form d = a + lambda b and set d dot c = 0.
logical_steps: Step 3: Solve linear equation in lambda

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Substituting lambda = -11/5 makes the dot product with c equal to zero.
